title: PCG logs over 80,000 passengers at ports nationwide ahead of Undas

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 80,000 passengers passed through ports nationwide on Thursday, as Filipinos traveled ahead of the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) reported. In its latest tally covering noon to 6 p.m., the PCG recorded 40,503 outbound passengers and 43,593 inbound passengers. READ: Naia logs almost 300,000 passengers ahead of Undas 2026 The PCG said it deployed a total of 6,082 frontline personnel to ensure the safety in ports amid the expected surge of passengers during Undas.
